latestVersion.changelog:
audio-to-video v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Convert MP3, WAV, M4A, AAC audio files (up to 200MB) into 1080p captioned video files.
- Cloud-powered rendering returns MP4s ready for social media in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic session/token workflow with free anonymous credits for new users.
- Intuitive chat commands: upload, export, check credits, and refine video with text prompts.
- Full support for auto-captions, waveform visuals, and multiple language GUI instructions.
